newsitem.title: UK: Dominion to help boost E.Midlands investment.
newsitem.headline: Dominion to help boost E.Midlands investment.

text.p: U.S. group Dominion Resources Inc's East Midlands Electricity Plc said on Friday it had formed a venture to boost U.S. investment in Britain's East Midlands region.
The venture would provide Britain's East Midlands Development Co with offices and other resources at Dominion's headquarters in Richmond, Va.

"Not only have we gained from the provision of offices and administrative support, we are also benefiting from the considerable contacts that Dominion has in the U.S. and Canada," the EMDC said in a joint statement.
Dominion agreed late last year to buy East Midlands Electricity, one of Britain's last independent regional electricity companies, in a recommended offer worth some $2.15 billion.
